protocol.status: Frozen complete-word visible readout, no interventions
protocol.question: Does complete quoted-word probability provide a usable chat readout on every fresh visible-control cell?
protocol.scope: 24 visible contexts: four fresh fruit/music/neutral triplets under two unchanged chat wordings. Score fixed candidate continuations without sampling, training, donors, hooks or detection evaluation.
free_templates: Give one word related to the sentence. Respond with one quoted word.
Give one possible association with the sentence. Respond with one quoted word.
protocol.candidate_policy: For each unchanged bank word, lowercase, initial-capital and uppercase; bare and one leading space; include closing quotation mark. Encode in full rendered context and require unchanged prefix tokenization. Deduplicate complete token sequences; no sequence may be a prefix of another. Preserve all subword tokens. No first-token truncation or length normalization.
protocol.scoring: Sum conditional log probabilities along each complete candidate token path, including closing quote. Sum disjoint candidate probabilities by bank using logsumexp. Report natural-log fruit/music ratio, full bank masses, and difference from the paired neutral score. This is likelihood scoring, not generated-answer accuracy and not KL.
protocol.execution: Score each unique nonterminal candidate prefix once using next-token probabilities; same-depth prefixes may share a batch, with no padding or KV cache. Only last-position logits are needed. Branches sharing a prefix use the same probability distribution.
protocol.serial_check: For the first multi-prefix batch in each context, compare the first prefix batched against a separate serial forward on its required child tokens. Stop if maximum absolute log-probability difference exceeds 0.25 nats; record differences. This is a bounded BF16 check, not exact numerical equivalence.
protocol.decision: Every one of the 16 fruit/music control cells must pass all three gates. Do not average away failed carriers or drop a wording. Neutral contexts are paired baselines. Stop after scoring; no perturbation or detection stage follows automatically.
protocol.limits: Same vocabulary chosen after earlier pilots, hand-authored visible controls, two repeated wordings and one checkpoint. Complete token paths address segmentation, not all semantic vocabulary coverage. Closing-quote likelihood changes the metric relative to earlier first-token scores. No p-values, consciousness or circuit claims.
